record.paper: Coloring count cones of planar graphs

dossier_meta.paper: Coloring count cones of planar graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: Does there exist a polynomial-time algorithm which, given a near-triangulation $G$ with the outer face bounded by a 4-cycle $C$ and a 4-coloring $\psi$ of $C$, correctly decides whether $\psi$ extends to a 4-coloring of $G$?
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors note that even very basic precoloring extension questions for planar graphs are wide open. There exist infinitely many near-triangulations $G$ whose outer 4-cycle has a precoloring that does not extend to a 4-coloring of $G$, yet no good characterization of such graphs is known.
